name: @aikit/crm-studio
description: Safety-first CRM Growth Studio for EmDash users, profiles, segments, and audited audience ingestion.

scripts.build: tsc && tsdown src/sandbox-entry.ts --format esm --platform browser --target es2022 --out-dir dist --no-clean --sourcemap && cp dist/sandbox-entry.js dist/sandbox.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node test/domain.test.mjs && node test/file-config.test.mjs && node test/scoring.test.mjs && node test/statistics.test.mjs && node test/sandbox-routes.test.mjs && node test/growth-routes.test.mjs && node test/sandbox-bundle.test.mjs
